selected_script.angle: Back strain and floor scratching protection during heavy appliance cleaning
selected_script.hook: Stop hurting your back trying to move heavy appliances to clean behind them

usage_steps_used: Loosen the fixing screw at the center of the stand
Pull the metal frame to adjust length to match appliance base
Tighten the fixing screw to lock length in place
Place the two stands parallel under each side of the appliance base
Press down the brake pads at the ends to fix stands in place

script_record.0-3s_pain_conflict: An adult home user strains and struggles to pull a heavy washing machine away from the laundry room wall, visibly stressing their back and scratching the wood floor.
script_record.3-6s_product_solution: The user introduces the silver-white metallic telescopic frame. They loosen the center joint fixing screw, slide the frame to adjust the length, tighten the screw, and place two stands parallel under the appliance base.
script_record.6-10s_fast-cut_scene_1: Close-up of the front brake levers on both stands being pressed down firmly by a foot to secure the dolly stands under the washing machine.
script_record.10-14s_fast-cut_scene_2: A different scene showing a large refrigerator supported by the parallel dollies. A hand pushes the refrigerator forward smoothly, highlighting floor clearance.
script_record.14-18s_fast-cut_scene_3: The washing machine operating stably on top of the dollies with the black anti-slip top pads absorbing vibration, the brake pads pressed down securely.
script_record.18-20s_cta: A simple upgrade for everyday home cleaning and moving. Check it out today.
